observations: headline
A blind reader can identify the fixture headline as the place to edit the words.
artwork
A blind reader can identify the illustration asset or asset ID as the way to replace the leaf.
placement
A blind reader can point to one actual nutrition recipe property and correctly predict the visible effect of editing it.
scene
The diagram puts the recipe in Node.js at render time and connects its styled scene to CSS in the exported HTML.
satori
The reader correctly traces the Satori path through SVG, with resvg rasterizing SVG for PNG.
chromium
The reader correctly traces Playwright driving Chromium to lay out HTML and capture PNG.
delivery
The reader can distinguish selectable text in offline HTML from pixels in a PNG and understands either backend can export HTML.
depth
At least two distinguishable planes or equivalent depth cues visually relate recognizable parts of the nutrition poster.
annotation
At 400 CSS pixels wide, the reviewer can associate two legible annotations with the correct pictured components, without zoom.
visualInference
With explanatory prose covered, a blind reader can point to two separate components and explain one relationship that the composition communicates.
rebuild
In an isolated fresh copy of the packet, the documented single command regenerates both deliverables after the exported files are moved aside.
edit
In that isolated copy, one caption edit followed by the same render command changes the visible caption in both outputs.
